summary.text: John Betancourt is the Democratic candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Kevin Sparks.
He is a former Amarillo school board member and a member of the Amarillo College Board of Regents.

paragraphs.text: John Betancourt graduated from Caprock High School and works as a senior manufacturing resource analyst.

According to Ballotpedia, he was a senior manufacturing resource analyst with Bell Helicopter-Textron while on the school board, and from 2002 until 2011 he was a site administrator for Texas Tech University.
Betancourt won an at-large seat on the Amarillo Independent School District board in the May 9, 2015 election and served from 2015 to 2019.
He ran for re-election in the May 4, 2019 election and did not win one of the three seats.

He was the Democratic candidate for Texas State Board of Education District 15 in 2020, losing the general election to Jay Johnson, and was elected to a six-year term on the Amarillo College Board of Regents on May 1, 2021.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 31.
